title: [ingest] Shadow benchmark defaults to depth 2, scale 0.5, decay 0.65
summary: The diffusion-shadow benchmark ships with `maxDepth: 2`, `diffusionScale: 0.5`, and `decay: 0.65`. Those defaults define the benchmark's shape and are easy to misread as incidental tuning.
